# gitea_repository_actions_workflow_state (Resource)

`gitea_repository_actions_workflow_state` manages the enabled state of an existing repository workflow.

Deleting the resource only removes it from Terraform state and leaves the remote workflow unchanged.

Import expects the resource ID in the form `owner:repo:workflow_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gitea_repository_actions_workflow_state" "example" {
  repository_owner = "my-org"
  repository       = "my-repo"
  workflow_id      = "ci.yml"
  enabled          = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the workflow is enabled.
- `repository` (String) The repository name.
- `repository_owner` (String) The repository owner.
- `workflow_id` (String) The workflow ID or file name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String) The workflow display name.
- `path` (String) The workflow file path.
- `state` (String) The workflow state returned by Gitea.
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Using `import` blocks in Terraform v1.5.0 and later:

```terraform
import {
  to = gitea_repository_actions_workflow_state.example
  id = "<owner>:<repo>:<workflow_id>"
}
```

Using `terraform import` in Terraform v1.4.0 and earlier:

```shell
terraform import gitea_repository_actions_workflow_state.example <owner>:<repo>:<workflow_id>
```
